# Flash Forward Foundation

> Flash Forward Foundation is a student-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 39-3605570) in Bellevue, Washington. Student interns build $5.17 solar study lights and send them through partner organizations to students who have no electricity after dark. As of October 2026, 72 lights have been delivered: 42 to Brighten Haiti, 15 to Loksadhana in Maharashtra, India, and 15 to Malaika in Kalebuka, DR Congo.

## About the organization

- [About Us: A Student-Run Nonprofit in Bellevue, WA](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/about/): Who we are and how the organization runs.
- [Leadership](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/about/team/): The student executives, advisors and interns.
- [501(c)(3) Status & EIN 39-3605570](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/nonprofit-status/): 501(c)(3) public charity, EIN 39-3605570, with IRS documents.
- [FAQ: Solar Study Lights, Donations & Internships](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/faq/): Common questions about the program.
- [Contact](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/contact/): Reach the team at about@flashforwardfoundation.org.

## Ways to help

- [Sponsor a Solar Study Light for $5.17](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/donate/): $5.17 covers the parts for one light.
- [Student Nonprofit Internship in Bellevue, WA](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/get-involved/internship/): Student internships in Bellevue.
- [Start a fundraiser](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/news/start-a-fundraiser/): Run a group fundraiser for study lights.
- [Get Involved: Student Internships in Bellevue](https://flashforwardfoundation.org/get-involved/): More ways to help.
